outputs.explanation: Panel A consists of micrographs (MitoTracker, DsRed, GFP, merge) only; no plot/bar chart is present.
Panel B includes bar charts (JC-1 relative intensity and anti-HMGB1 intensity) showing means with error bars but no individual data points overlaid, despite n=20 being reported.
Panel C is a western blot image, not a plot, so individual data points are not applicable.
Panel D contains bar charts of SDH and COX signal intensity showing group means with error bars and sample sizes (N) noted in the bars, but no individual data points are overlaid.

The quantitative plots in panel E are FACS histograms (cell count vs TMRM intensity), which are line/distribution plots exempt from requiring individual data point overlays; the other elements are schematics.
